about.html:
Hello again,

You've found my website. Whether by accident or on purpose(!), I'm going to try and tell you a bit more about myself.

I graduated from King's College London in 2018, with a European Studies BA Hons. Since Brexit entered into our vocabulary, everyone seems to understand the relevance of Europe. However, in 2014 when I first began my studies, the majority of people did not see the point. These days, the tune has changed slightly and I'm always right on the edge of saying, "I told you so".

My research interests include, Empires, ethnic minority identity in France and the UK, feminist theory and European identity.

On graduation I started working for Student LifeStart, an online student platform set up by Virgin Money. How did I find myself there? Well....In 2017, I was interning at the Victoria and Albert Museum. I met an incredible woman called Eva Liparova who got me involved in the project and in hindsight, it was probably the best post-uni job EVER. I learnt so much, being part of the LifeStart story from beginning, middle and end. Going from part-time student to full-time remote freelancer.

In February 2019, I began working for Globelynx, part of the Press Association, whilst also studying part-time for a news-reporting NCTJ diploma.

After some soul-searching, I decided I needed a big change. So I thought, why not go back to my heritage? I went to live in the country my grandparents left over 50 years ago. I lived there permanently from 2019-2023.

So, in October 2019, I moved to Kingston, Jamaica. I worked for a national broadcaster (CVMTV). After 18 months I transitioned to one of the leading production and advertising agencies in the Caribbean as a senior content creative. The LAB was an incredible opportunity to work on leading brand campaigns as well as begin to explore film and television writing and development.

I am very thankful I managed to find my feet in a country that was so foreign yet also strangely familiar. It feels like home and I still return once a year!

On leaving Jamaica I relocated to Rotterdam in the Netherlands. There I pursued a master's in Media and Creative Industries. My research interests included Jamaica's film industry development, digital streaming companies e.g. MUBI and creative careers.

Upon submitting my thesis, I packed my bags again and found myself back in London. I worked for BBC Studios, across series development and production and now am working as an assistant producer with CREATE, the global brand studio of CNN. You can see all my previous work by looking at Projects, or here's my LinkedIn.

My current aspirations include; working on more film and documentary projects, helping to build the film industry in Jamaica and collaborating with people to make sure that happens. If you think you can help me achieve this or you'd like me to work with you on a project, idea or strategy then I'm only an email away.

Drop me a line: Cleoa@hotmail.co.uk or see my full work experience via Linkedin

services.title: Like what you see? Let's work together! I support underrepresented creatives to get their stories told internationally. I can help you in script development, facilitate workshops, speak at events, or provide cultural consultancy. I will support your project at any stage - from development, production, post-production, distribution and beyond!

Do you have a project but not sure what is next? Or do you want to take your script to the next level? Whatever stage you're at, I can support your development as a script editor or development executive as needed. Working with you to uncover the best next steps of your project. I can support the idea stage to scripting, or be responsible for grant fund applications.

While my mission is to raise the profile of creatives, I can also step out from behind the scenes and facilitate workshops on empowering filmmakers, creative storytelling, personal branding and networking.
services.html: I have successfully facilitated 2 film workshops in Kingston, Jamaica, with the kind support of JAFTA.

services.title: As a trained broadcast journalist, I am happy to take to the floor and speak on a variety of topics. My specialities include the Jamaican film industry, the creative industries, media trends, and current affairs. I am an expert who is committed to sharing researched opinions with large and small audiences.

Do you have a project but want to ensure that it's culturally sensitive/nuanced/accurate? British-Jamaican, I am able to support international projects that want to film in the Caribbean, or present Caribbean themes and characters accurately.
